svg.title: Invitation: distinguish practical text from its background
svg.desc: Only four practical text fills change from #929f96 to #17352f on the identical solid #f4f1e8 panel. Specified-color contrast changes from 2.44:1 to 11.72:1. All copy, font sizes/weights, anchors, baselines, panel, photographs/crops, paper, other colors and lighting remain fixed. Fictional print invitation; not a full accessibility assessment.
